specifications.metric: WirelessHART mesh installation cost saving vs wired instruments
specifications.basis: Quoted on the WirelessHART technology page from the 'WirelessHART User Case Studies - web publishing' brochure: 'WirelessHART offers 30%-60% lower installation costs than adding traditional wired instruments'

As printed on the page: 'By design, WirelessHART using mesh networking technology' and 'a device doesn't have to communicate directly to a gateway, but just forward its message to the next closest device'
specifications.value: self-organizing, self-healing mesh; each device can route for other devices

specifications.metric: Installation cost saving vs wired instruments
specifications.basis: FieldComm Group: 'WirelessHART offers 30%-60% lower installation costs than adding traditional wired instruments.'
'Each WirelessHART network includes three main elements: Wireless field devices ... Gateways ... A Network Manager ...'

'WirelessHART using mesh networking technology. Each device in a mesh network can serve as a router for messages from other devices. ... provides redundant communication routes to increase reliability'

'supports multiple messaging modes including one-way publishing of process and control values, spontaneous notification by exception, ad-hoc request/response, and auto-segmented block transfers of large data sets'
'The HART Protocol Specifications kit is a collection of 17 documents that specify the different aspects of the protocol and test procedures for field devices.'
